item.title: Prompt injection is not a prompt problem
item.description: Prompt injection persists because an LLM sees instructions and untrusted data on the same channel, with no structural way to tell them apart. Defences written as prompt text can always be overridden by more text. What actually holds is architectural: scope every tool to least privilege, treat all model output as untrusted input, and put a human gate in front of irreversible actions.
